sources.entry: SwiftBiu - Text productivity tool with a customizable action bar and AI extensions. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/swiftbiu/id6754772331?platform=mac)

summary.name: SwiftBiu
summary.one_liner: SwiftBiu is a macOS context-action tool that brings translate, search, file compression, OCR and plugin actions to selected text, files and on-screen text.
use_cases: translate or search selected text in any app
compress images or videos from Finder
extract text from a screen region with OCR
run custom JavaScript or web plugins on text or files
set different trigger rules per app
summary.what_it_does:
SwiftBiu shows a native toolbar when text or files are selected, or runs actions directly via shortcuts, gestures, file drag-and-drop, OCR triggers or per-app rules. Built-in actions include translate, search, format, copy, open links, image and video compression, image format conversion, background removal, AirDrop, Finder reveal and AI actions. Its OCR feature lets you draw a box around screen text and copy or translate the result. It supports JavaScript plugins and HTML/CSS/JavaScript web extensions that appear alongside built-in actions. Version 1.4.0 adds multi-source parallel translation with bilingual comparison, customizable toolbar appearance, and a device seat management panel for Pro status.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
notable: Context-aware triggers: copy trigger, text gestures, file drag directions, and OCR screen capture
Extensible via JavaScript plugins and HTML/CSS/JS web extensions
Per-app rule configuration with inheritance from global defaults
Developer data: page states no data is collected by the developer
caveats: Free download with in-app purchases; some features require Pro membership
Mac-only (App Store listing states macOS only)
Pro status syncs across a limited number of authorized desktop devices (seat management)
